CFML Language Reference

CFML Language Reference

This reference describes every tag and function that the KoldFusion 4.5 server understands, with the syntax, the attributes or parameters, notes on how KoldFusion behaves, and an example you can run. Entries marked 4.5 are new in this release.

Alphabetical lists: all 73 tags · all 251 functions · CFML Quick Reference · Snippets Launcher

Chapter 1: CFML Tags

Variable manipulation | Flow control | Exception handling | Output and page processing | Database manipulation | Application framework | Extensibility | Internet protocols | File, directory and system | Data interchange | Verity search | Security | Forms

Variable manipulation

CFCOOKIESends a cookie to the browser, or deletes one.
CFPARAMChecks that a variable exists, optionally gives it a default value and checks its type.
CFSETCreates a variable or changes its value.

Flow control

CFABORTStops processing the page at the tag, optionally with an error message.
CFBREAKLeaves the innermost CFLOOP immediately.
CFEXITLeaves a custom tag early, or loops back through its end tag.
CFIF/CFELSEIF/CFELSERuns a block of code only when an expression is true, with optional alternatives.
CFINCLUDEProcesses another CFML template as if its code were part of the current page.
CFLOCATIONSends the browser to another URL and ends the current page.
CFLOOPRepeats a block of code: a counted loop, a conditional loop, or a loop over a query, list or structure.
CFSCRIPTEncloses a block of script code written in the JavaScript-like CFScript language.
CFSWITCH/CFCASE/CFDEFAULTCASEChooses one of several blocks of code by comparing an expression with a list of values.

Exception handling

CFERRORNames a template to show instead of the standard error message when a page fails.
CFRETHROW 4.5Raises the current exception again from inside a CFCATCH block.
CFTHROWRaises a custom error that can be caught with CFTRY/CFCATCH.
CFTRY/CFCATCHCatches errors raised inside a block of code and handles them with your own code.

Output and page processing

CFCACHESaves the generated page to a file and serves that copy to later visitors.
CFCOLDefines one column of a CFTABLE.
CFCONTENTSets the MIME type of the response and optionally sends a file instead of the page.
CFHEADERAdds an HTTP header to the response or sets the HTTP status code.
CFHTMLHEADWrites text into the HEAD section of the page being generated.
CFOUTPUTEvaluates the #expressions# in its body and writes the result, optionally once per query row or group.
CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE 4.5Compresses runs of whitespace in the output generated by its body.
CFSETTINGControls page-level processing settings such as output outside CFOUTPUT and debug output.
CFSILENT 4.5Runs the CFML in its body but throws away all the output it generates.
CFTABLEBuilds a table from a query, either as preformatted text or as an HTML table.

Database manipulation

CFINSERTInserts the fields of a submitted form as a new row of a table, without writing any SQL.
CFPROCPARAMPasses one parameter to a stored procedure called with CFSTOREDPROC.
CFPROCRESULTNames a result set returned by a stored procedure called with CFSTOREDPROC.
CFQUERYPasses SQL statements to a data source and returns the result set as a query.
CFQUERYPARAM 4.5Binds a typed, validated value into the SQL of a CFQUERY.
CFSTOREDPROCCalls a stored procedure in a data source.
CFTRANSACTIONGroups several CFQUERY operations into a single database transaction.
CFUPDATEUpdates an existing table row from the fields of a submitted form, without writing any SQL.

Application framework

CFAPPLICATIONNames the application and switches on application, session and client variables.
CFLOCKMakes sure only one request at a time runs a block of code (or only readers run it together).

Extensibility

CFASSOCIATELets a nested custom tag pass its attributes to an ancestor custom tag.
CFMODULECalls a custom tag by template path or by name.
CFOBJECTCreates a COM, CORBA or Java object. Not available in KoldFusion for UNIX.
CFREPORTRuns a Crystal Reports report. Not available in KoldFusion for UNIX.
CFSERVLET 4.5Runs a Java servlet on a JRun servlet engine and returns its output. Not available in KoldFusion.
CFSERVLETPARAM 4.5Passes a parameter to the servlet called by CFSERVLET.
CFX Tags (CFX_HELLO, CFX_DICE, CFX_SYSINFO)Sample CFX tags (compiled C extensions) that ship with KoldFusion: a greeting, a dice roller and a system query.

Internet protocols

CFFTPOpens an FTP connection and lists, transfers, renames and deletes files on the remote server.
CFHTTPFetches a page or file from a Web server with an HTTP GET or POST.
CFHTTPPARAMAdds a URL parameter, form field, cookie, header or file to a CFHTTP request.
CFLDAPQueries and updates an LDAP directory server.
CFMAILSends an e-mail message, or one message per row or group of a query.
CFMAILPARAM 4.5Attaches a file or adds a custom header to a message sent with CFMAIL.
CFPOPRetrieves or deletes messages in a POP3 mailbox.

File, directory and system

CFDIRECTORYLists, creates, renames and deletes directories on the server.
CFEXECUTE 4.5Runs a program on the server and captures what it prints.
CFFILEUploads, reads, writes, copies, moves, renames and deletes files on the server.
CFREGISTRYReads, writes and deletes keys and values in the system registry.
CFSCHEDULECreates, updates, deletes and runs tasks in the KoldFusion scheduler.

Data interchange

CFWDDXConverts CFML data to and from WDDX packets, and to JavaScript.

Verity search

CFCOLLECTIONCreates, maps, repairs, optimizes or deletes a Verity search collection.
CFINDEXAdds documents, files or query rows to a Verity collection, or removes them.
CFSEARCHSearches one or more Verity collections and returns the matches as a query.

Security

CFAUTHENTICATELogs a user in to a security context of Advanced Security.
CFIMPERSONATERuns a block of code as another user of a security context.

Forms

CFAPPLETEmbeds a Java applet registered in the Administrator into a CFFORM.
CFFORMBuilds an HTML form with automatic JavaScript input validation.
CFGRIDDisplays query data in a grid that users can browse, follow links from or edit.
CFGRIDCOLUMNDefines one column of a CFGRID.
CFGRIDROWAdds one row of literal data to a CFGRID that has no query.
CFGRIDUPDATEWrites the edits made in a CFGRID back to a database table.
CFINPUTCreates a text, password, radio button or check box control with client-side validation.
CFSELECTCreates a drop-down list or list box, optionally filled from a query.
CFSLIDERCreates a control for picking a number from a range.
CFTEXTINPUTCreates a styled single-line text entry control with validation.
CFTREEDisplays a hierarchical tree of items the user can expand, collapse and select.
CFTREEITEMAdds an item, or a whole branch built from a query, to a CFTREE.

Chapter 2: CFML Functions

Array | Authentication | Date and time | Decision | Display and formatting | Dynamic evaluation | International | List | Mathematical | Query | String | Structure | System | Other

Array functions

ArrayAppendAdds an element to the end of an array.
ArrayAvgReturns the average of the values in a numeric array.
ArrayClearRemoves all elements from an array.
ArrayDeleteAtDeletes an element from an array and closes the gap.
ArrayInsertAtInserts a value into an array at a given position.
ArrayIsEmptyDetermines whether an array has no elements.
ArrayLenReturns the number of elements in an array.
ArrayMaxReturns the largest number in an array.
ArrayMinReturns the smallest number in an array.
ArrayNewCreates an empty array of one, two or three dimensions.
ArrayPrependAdds an element to the beginning of an array.
ArrayResizeMakes an array at least a given number of elements long.
ArraySetSets a range of array elements to the same value.
ArraySortSorts the elements of an array in place.
ArraySumReturns the sum of the values in a numeric array.
ArraySwapSwaps two elements of an array.
ArrayToListConverts a one-dimensional array to a delimited list.

Authentication functions

AuthenticatedContextReturns the name of the security context the user authenticated in.
AuthenticatedUserReturns the name of the user authenticated by CFAUTHENTICATE.
IsAuthenticatedReturns YES if the visitor has been authenticated by CFAUTHENTICATE.
IsAuthorizedReturns YES if the authenticated user may perform an action on a resource.
IsProtectedReturns YES if a resource is covered by an Advanced Security rule.

Date and time functions

CreateDateReturns a date/time value for a year, month and day.
CreateDateTimeReturns a date/time value for a year, month, day, hour, minute and second.
CreateODBCDateReturns a date in ODBC date format, {d 'yyyy-mm-dd'}.
CreateODBCDateTimeReturns a date/time in ODBC timestamp format, {ts 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'}.
CreateODBCTimeReturns a time in ODBC time format, {t 'hh:mm:ss'}.
CreateTimeReturns a date/time value for an hour, minute and second.
CreateTimeSpanReturns a time span (a number of days) for use with date arithmetic and query caching.
DateAddAdds a number of years, months, days, hours, etc. to a date.
DateCompareCompares two dates and returns -1, 0 or 1.
DateConvertConverts a date/time between local time and Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
DateDiffReturns the number of whole units (years, days, hours, ...) between two dates.
DatePartReturns one part (year, month, weekday, hour, ...) of a date as a number.
DayReturns the day of the month (1-31) of a date.
DayOfWeekReturns the day of the week (1 = Sunday to 7 = Saturday) of a date.
DayOfWeekAsStringReturns the name of a weekday (1 = Sunday) as a string.
DayOfYearReturns the day of the year (1-366) of a date.
DaysInMonthReturns the number of days in the month of a date.
DaysInYearReturns the number of days (365 or 366) in the year of a date.
FirstDayOfMonthReturns the day of the year on which the month of a date begins.
GetHTTPTimeString 4.5Formats a date/time as a GMT string for HTTP headers.
GetTimeZoneInfoReturns a structure describing the server's time zone.
HourReturns the hour (0-23) of a date/time.
IsLeapYearReturns YES if a year is a leap year.
MinuteReturns the minute (0-59) of a date/time.
MonthReturns the month (1-12) of a date.
MonthAsStringReturns the name of a month (1 = January) as a string.
NowReturns the current date and time of the server.
ParseDateTimeConverts a date/time string into a date/time value.
QuarterReturns the quarter of the year (1-4) of a date.
SecondReturns the second (0-59) of a date/time.
WeekReturns the week of the year (1-53) of a date.
YearReturns the year of a date, always with four digits.

Decision functions

IsArrayDetermines whether a value is an array, optionally of a given dimension.
IsBinary 4.5Determines whether a value is binary data.
IsBooleanDetermines whether a value can be converted to a Boolean.
IsDateDetermines whether a string can be converted to a date/time value.
IsDebugModeDetermines whether debugging output is turned on for the current page.
IsDefinedDetermines whether a variable with the given name exists.
IsNumericDetermines whether a string can be converted to a number.
IsNumericDateDetermines whether a value is a number that can be used as a date/time value.
IsQueryDetermines whether a value is a query.
IsSimpleValueDetermines whether a value is a simple value (string, number, Boolean or date).
IsStructDetermines whether a value is a structure.
IsWDDXDetermines whether a string is a WDDX packet.
ParameterExistsDetermines whether a variable exists (obsolete; use IsDefined).

Display and formatting functions

DateFormatFormats the date part of a date/time value using a mask.
DecimalFormatFormats a number with two decimal places and thousands separators.
DollarFormatFormats a number as a U.S. dollar amount.
HTMLCodeFormatEscapes HTML special characters and wraps the result in PRE tags.
HTMLEditFormatEscapes HTML special characters so text displays literally.
NumberFormatFormats a number using a mask.
ParagraphFormatTurns blank lines in plain text into HTML paragraph breaks.
TimeFormatFormats the time part of a date/time value using a mask.
YesNoFormatDisplays a boolean value as Yes or No.

Dynamic evaluation functions

DEWraps a string in double quotes so that a later evaluation returns it unchanged.
EvaluateEvaluates one or more strings as CFML expressions and returns the last result.
IIfPicks one of two string expressions based on a condition and evaluates it.
SetVariableAssigns a value to a variable whose name is given as a string.

International functions

GetLocaleReturns the name of the current locale.
LSCurrencyFormatFormats a number as money for the current locale.
LSDateFormatFormats the date part of a date/time value for the current locale.
LSEuroCurrencyFormatFormats a number as an amount in euros.
LSIsCurrencyTests whether a string is a currency amount in the current locale.
LSIsDateTests whether a string is a date/time value in the current locale.
LSIsNumericTests whether a string is a number in the current locale.
LSNumberFormatFormats a number using a mask, for the current locale.
LSParseCurrencyConverts a currency string in the current locale to a number.
LSParseDateTimeConverts a date/time string in the current locale to a date/time value.
LSParseEuroCurrencyConverts a euro currency string to a number.
LSParseNumberConverts a numeric string in the current locale to a number.
LSTimeFormatFormats the time part of a date/time value for the current locale.
SetLocaleSets the locale used by the LS functions and returns the previous one.

List functions

ListAppendAdds an element to the end of a list.
ListChangeDelimsChanges the delimiters of a list.
ListContainsFinds the first list element that contains a substring (case-sensitive).
ListContainsNoCaseFinds the first list element that contains a substring, ignoring case.
ListDeleteAtRemoves the element at a given position from a list.
ListFindFinds an element in a list (case-sensitive).
ListFindNoCaseFinds an element in a list, ignoring case.
ListFirstReturns the first element of a list.
ListGetAtReturns the element at a given position in a list.
ListInsertAtInserts an element into a list at a given position.
ListLastReturns the last element of a list.
ListLenReturns the number of elements in a list.
ListPrependAdds an element to the beginning of a list.
ListQualifyPuts a qualifier, such as quotes, around each element of a list.
ListRestReturns a list without its first element.
ListSetAtReplaces the element at a given position in a list.
ListSortSorts the elements of a list.
ListToArrayConverts a list to a one-dimensional array.
ListValueCountCounts how many list elements equal a value (case-sensitive).
ListValueCountNoCaseCounts how many list elements equal a value, ignoring case.

Mathematical functions

AbsReturns the absolute value of a number.
ACosReturns the arccosine of a number, in radians.
ASinReturns the arcsine of a number, in radians.
AtnReturns the arctangent of a number, in radians.
BitAndPerforms a bitwise logical AND of two integers.
BitMaskClearClears a run of bits in an integer.
BitMaskReadReads a run of bits from an integer.
BitMaskSetWrites a value into a run of bits of an integer.
BitNotPerforms a bitwise logical NOT (one's complement) of an integer.
BitOrPerforms a bitwise logical OR of two integers.
BitSHLNShifts the bits of an integer to the left.
BitSHRNShifts the bits of an integer to the right.
BitXorPerforms a bitwise logical exclusive OR of two integers.
CeilingReturns the smallest integer greater than or equal to a number.
CosReturns the cosine of an angle given in radians.
DecrementValueReturns the integer part of a number, decreased by one.
ExpReturns e raised to a power.
FixRemoves the fractional part of a number, rounding toward zero.
FormatBaseNConverts a number to a string in a given base (radix).
IncrementValueReturns the integer part of a number, increased by one.
InputBaseNConverts a string in a given base (radix) to a decimal integer.
IntReturns the largest integer less than or equal to a number.
LogReturns the natural logarithm of a number.
Log10Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.
MaxReturns the larger of two numbers.
MinReturns the smaller of two numbers.
PiReturns the constant pi.
RandReturns a random number between 0 and 1.
RandomizeSeeds the random number generator.
RandRangeReturns a random integer in a range.
RoundRounds a number to the nearest integer.
SgnReturns the sign of a number: -1, 0 or 1.
SinReturns the sine of an angle given in radians.
SqrReturns the square root of a number.
TanReturns the tangent of an angle given in radians.

Query functions

QueryAddColumnAdds a column to a query and fills it from an array.
QueryAddRowAdds empty rows to a query.
QueryNewCreates an empty query with the given columns.
QuerySetCellSets the value of one cell in a query.
QuotedValueListReturns all values of a query column as a list of quoted strings.
ValueListReturns all values of a query column as a list.

String functions

AscReturns the ASCII code of the first character of a string.
ChrReturns the character for an ASCII code.
CJustifyCenters a string in a field of a given width.
CompareCompares two strings, case-sensitively.
CompareNoCaseCompares two strings, ignoring case.
DecryptDecrypts a string that was encrypted with Encrypt.
EncryptEncrypts a string with a key.
FindFinds the first occurrence of a substring, case-sensitively.
FindNoCaseFinds the first occurrence of a substring, ignoring case.
FindOneOfFinds the first occurrence of any character from a set.
GetTokenReturns the nth token of a string, given a set of delimiters.
Hash 4.5Returns a one-way MD5 hash of a string.
InsertInserts a substring into a string after a given position.
JSStringFormat 4.5Escapes a string for use inside a JavaScript string literal.
LCaseConverts a string to lowercase.
LeftReturns the leftmost characters of a string.
LenReturns the length of a string or binary object.
LJustifyLeft-justifies a string in a field of a given width.
LTrimRemoves leading spaces from a string.
MidReturns characters from the middle of a string.
REFindSearches a string with a regular expression, case-sensitively.
REFindNoCaseSearches a string with a regular expression, ignoring case.
RemoveCharsRemoves characters from a string.
RepeatStringReturns a string repeated a given number of times.
ReplaceReplaces occurrences of a substring, case-sensitively.
ReplaceListReplaces each item of one list with the matching item of another.
ReplaceNoCaseReplaces occurrences of a substring, ignoring case.
REReplaceReplaces text matching a regular expression, case-sensitively.
REReplaceNoCaseReplaces text matching a regular expression, ignoring case.
ReverseReverses the order of the characters in a string.
RightReturns the rightmost characters of a string.
RJustifyRight-justifies a string in a field of a given width.
RTrimRemoves trailing spaces from a string.
SpanExcludingReturns the characters at the start of a string up to the first character from a set.
SpanIncludingReturns the characters at the start of a string that all belong to a set.
StripCRRemoves carriage-return characters from a string.
ToBase64 4.5Encodes a string or binary object in Base64.
ToBinary 4.5Decodes a Base64 string into a binary object.
ToString 4.5Converts a value, including a binary object, to a string.
TrimRemoves leading and trailing spaces from a string.
UCaseConverts a string to uppercase.
URLDecode 4.5Decodes a URL-encoded string.
URLEncodedFormatEncodes a string for safe use in a URL.
ValConverts the number at the beginning of a string to a number.
WrapWraps text so no line is longer than a given width.
XMLFormat 4.5Escapes a string for use in XML text.

Structure functions

Duplicate 4.5Returns a complete, independent copy of any variable.
StructAppend 4.5Copies all keys of one structure into another.
StructClearRemoves all keys from a structure.
StructCopyMakes a shallow copy of a structure.
StructCountReturns the number of keys in a structure.
StructDeleteRemoves a key from a structure.
StructFindReturns the value stored under a key.
StructFindKeySearches nested structures and arrays for keys with a given name.
StructFindValueSearches nested structures and arrays for keys with a given value.
StructGet 4.5Returns a structure at a variable path, creating it if needed.
StructInsertAdds a key-value pair to a structure.
StructIsEmptyDetermines whether a structure has no keys.
StructKeyArrayReturns the keys of a structure as an array.
StructKeyExistsDetermines whether a structure contains a key.
StructKeyListReturns the keys of a structure as a list.
StructNewCreates a new, empty structure.
StructSortReturns the top-level keys of a structure sorted by their values.
StructUpdateChanges the value of an existing key.

System functions

CreateObject 4.5Creates a COM, CORBA or Java object (not available in KoldFusion for UNIX).
DeleteClientVariableDeletes a client variable for the current visitor.
DirectoryExistsReturns YES if a directory exists on the server.
ExpandPathTurns a relative or URL-style path into an absolute file system path.
FileExistsReturns YES if a file exists on the server.
GetBaseTagDataReturns the data of an ancestor custom tag, from inside a nested custom tag.
GetBaseTagListReturns a comma-delimited list of the custom tags that enclose the current one.
GetBaseTemplatePathReturns the full path of the page that was requested.
GetClientVariablesListReturns a list of the client variables you can change for the current visitor.
GetCurrentTemplatePathReturns the full path of the template that contains the call.
GetDirectoryFromPathExtracts the directory part of an absolute path.
GetFileFromPathExtracts the file name from an absolute path.
GetFunctionList 4.5Returns a structure whose keys are the names of all built-in CFML functions.
GetHttpRequestDataReturns the HTTP request headers, body, method and protocol in a structure.
GetK2ServerCollectionsReturns the collections the Verity K2 Server serves.
GetK2ServerDocCountReturns the number of documents indexed in the Verity K2 Server's collections.
GetK2ServerDocCountLimitReturns the maximum number of documents the Verity K2 Server may index.
GetMetricData 4.5Returns server performance counters in a structure.
GetProfileStringReads one entry from a Windows-style initialization (.ini) file.
GetTempDirectoryReturns the path of the server's directory for temporary files.
GetTempFileCreates an empty file with a unique name and returns its path.
GetTemplatePathOlder name for GetBaseTemplatePath.
GetTickCountReturns a millisecond counter for timing code.
IsK2ServerABrokerTells whether the Verity K2 Server is a broker for other K2 Servers.
IsK2ServerDocCountExceededTells whether the Verity K2 Server holds more documents than its limit.
IsK2ServerOnlineTells whether the Verity K2 Server is running.
JavaCast 4.5Marks a value with a Java type for calls to overloaded Java methods.
SetProfileStringWrites one entry to a Windows-style initialization (.ini) file.

Other functions

CreateUUIDReturns a new Universally Unique Identifier as a 35-character string.
KFUSION_CHECKSYNTAXKoldFusion extension: checks a piece of CFML for syntax errors without running it.
PreserveSingleQuotesStops CFQUERY from escaping the single quotes in a variable.
WriteOutputWrites text to the page from inside CFSCRIPT.
